backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining data models (Product, Shop, Order, SupportTicket, ReturnRequest) and business logic for a local marketplace platform with role-based access control, blob storage, and user profile management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features related to shopkeeper authentication flow improvements, automatic query invalidation on approval status changes, and removal of unnecessary authentication barriers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration for customer, shopkeeper, and admin portals with authentication and role-based access control.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with custom OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode color tokens including Trust-Blue and Success-Green theme colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Local Market Hub application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component using TanStack Router to define all routes for customer, shopkeeper, and admin portals with authentication, profile setup modal, and loading states.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity authentication with query cache invalidation on logout and error handling for authentication state.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup allowing users to enter their name and select role (customer, shopkeeper, or admin) with form validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleGuard.t: A React component that restricts access to child components based on user roles (customer, shopkeeper, admin), displaying loading states, authentication prompts, or access denied messages as needed.
frontend/src/components/customer/CartIte: Displays a single cart item with product image, name, price, quantity controls (increment/decrement), and remove button, handling cart updates via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/customer/CartSid: A slide-out sheet component showing the shopping cart with all items, total price, and a checkout button, accessible via a floating action button with item count badge.
frontend/src/components/customer/OrderCa: Displays order details in a card format with status badge, expandable item list, and a return request button for delivered orders.
frontend/src/components/customer/Product: Shows product information (image, name, description, price, stock) in a card layout with a quick-add-to-cart button and category badge.
frontend/src/components/customer/ReturnR: A modal dialog for submitting return/exchange requests with a reason selector and optional description field for a specific order.
frontend/src/components/customer/ShopCar: Displays shop information (name, location, online status) in a card with a button to navigate to the shop's product listing.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout component with role-based navigation header, mobile menu support, and conditional rendering of CartSidebar for customers.
frontend/src/components/shared/CreateTic: Modal dialog component for creating support tickets with a textarea for issue description and form submission handling using the useCreateSupportTicket hook.
frontend/src/components/shopkeeper/Inven: Card component displaying product inventory details with edit and delete actions, showing product image, name, description, price, stock quantity, and category badge.
frontend/src/components/shopkeeper/Produ: Modal form component for adding or editing products with fields for name, description, price, quantity, category selection, and image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/shopkeeper/ShopO: Card component displaying order details for shopkeepers with status badges and action buttons to update order status through different workflow stages (pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Composite authentication hook that combines Internet Identity, actor, and user profile data to provide a unified authentication state and user information.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, handling login/logout flows, identity persistence, and providing authentication status throughout the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, shops, cart, orders, support tickets, and admin functions. Provides both query hooks (useGetProducts, useGetShops, etc.) and mutation hooks (useAddToCart, useCheckout, useApproveShop, etc.) with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components, trust indicators (trust-blue, success-green), and sidebar styling using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and wraps the App component with InternetIdentityProvider and QueryClientProvider for authentication and data fetching.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard displaying platform statistics including total shops, orders, revenue, and pending tickets in card-based layout with role guard protection for admin-only access.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AnalyticsPage.t: Admin analytics page showing transaction metrics including total platform sales, 2% commission collected, and total orders with placeholder for future subscription tracking feature.
frontend/src/pages/admin/SettingsPage.ts: Admin settings page with placeholder UI for future platform-wide configuration options, protected by admin role guard.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ShopManagementP: Admin shop management interface with tabs for pending and approved shops, allowing admins to review and approve shop registrations with toast notifications for success/error feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TicketsPage.tsx: Admin page for managing support tickets with tabs for open, in-progress, and resolved tickets, allowing status updates and displaying ticket counts.
frontend/src/pages/customer/CheckoutPage: Customer checkout page displaying cart items with product details, calculating subtotal with 2% commission, and handling order placement with navigation to orders page.
frontend/src/pages/customer/MyOrdersPage: Customer page displaying all orders sorted by timestamp with refresh functionality and using OrderCard component for each order.
frontend/src/pages/customer/MyTicketsPag: Customer/shopkeeper page for viewing support tickets with a button to create new tickets via CreateTicketModal, currently showing empty state.
frontend/src/pages/customer/ProductBrows: Customer page for browsing products with category filtering, displaying available products in a grid using ProductCard components.
frontend/src/pages/customer/ReturnReques: Customer page placeholder for return requests, currently showing only an empty state message.
frontend/src/pages/customer/ShopBrowsePa: Customer page for browsing local shops with location-based search functionality, displaying approved and open shops using ShopCard components.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero banner, three-portal overview (Customer, Shopkeeper, Admin), and role-based navigation that redirects authenticated users to their appropriate dashboard based on their AppRole.
frontend/src/pages/shopkeeper/InventoryP: Shopkeeper page for managing product inventory with add/edit functionality via ProductFormModal, showing approval status and product grid using InventoryProductCard.
frontend/src/pages/shopkeeper/LedgerPage: Displays a digital ledger for shopkeepers showing total sales, platform commission (2%), and net earnings with monthly breakdowns. Filters completed/delivered orders and shows pending approval state if shop is not yet approved.
frontend/src/pages/shopkeeper/OrdersPage: Shows incoming orders for shopkeepers sorted by timestamp. Displays pending approval message if shop is not approved, and renders ShopOrderCard components for each order.
frontend/src/pages/shopkeeper/ShopDashbo: Manages shop registration and status toggling (online/offline). Shows approval status notifications and allows shopkeepers to register their shop with name and location fields.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette (trust-blue, success-green), OKLCH color system, dark mode support, and extended theme settings for the UI component library.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a hyperlocal marketplace with Customer/Shopkeeper/Admin roles, Motoko backend, manual location filtering, and known limitations including lack of real-time features and complex shopkeeper login flow after approval.
